reviews.text: Hi Star! Your 5-star review made our day! We're delighted you had a great experience. Looking forward to your next visit!
Amazing Customer Service.  I will return to this store over and over as long as their team stays this courteous and helpful
Hi Mary! Thanks for the fantastic 5-star review! We're thrilled you had a great experience. Hope to see you and your pets again soon!

Took my dog in today for a nail trim.  He is a large dog and I told her that every time he goes there, they have to put him on the table.  I told her he won't allow it if he isn't restrained on the table- its literally WHY we take him to get them done.  She said she could do it on the floor.  He fought, as I knew he would.  She kept threatening to stop and said he would be sorry if he bit her.  He is not aggressive nor a biter, but he will fight to get away when clipping his nails.  He head butt her when he swung around to pull away.  She got mad.  I told her again that he is usually put on the table.  She said, "if I put him on the table and he breaks it, I'm charging you $1300, but I guess so, if that's what you want".  For one, how would he break the table?  I didn't see a weight, breed or size limit when booking, so you should be prepared for all weights, breeds and sizes.  The other worker held him down, they didn't keep him restrained with the neck collar attached to the table and put weight on him instead.  He is now severely limping, his eyes are bloodshot and that is the absolute last time we will go there.  It was chaotic at best and now he is hurt.
Took my mixed Westie in for haircut as I am now unable.  They did a great job, even asked me about her glands, glad they did. She looks great in a short time. My thanks!
Hi Forest! We appreciate the 5-star love. Looking forward to your next visit!
Super friendly , love how i can bring my  pup for a bath here and they provide towels  and shampoo

Exceptional customer experience at the Jones rd location!! Very kind and helpful team members made a very elevated experience for me. Shout out to Jordan and Michele who interacted with me directly in an above and beyond way. I will definitely be returning, thank you for making this location great and creating such a welcoming environment.
Hi Shelby! Your 5-star review made our day! We're thrilled to be your go-to spot for pet supplies. See you again soon!
My experience was great and they were very timely and professional
Hi Cris! We appreciate the great rating. We're always here to help with all your pet needs. Visit us again soon!

JORDAN, EDEN, Stephanie MADE OUR DAY! Even though we came in late before they closed on a Sunday, Jordan did not push us to leave. They we're  all super knowledgeable, patient demeanor made me want to make this location our MAIN pet supplies store eventhough we have a pet store within walking distance from our home. By rule of thumb, I like to go to a place where people actually enjoy their jobs! God bless y'all! 😁
Hi Whitney! A big thank you for the 5-star shoutout! We're so happy you enjoyed your time here. Come back anytime for more pet adventures!
Nice atmosphere and good selection

I've been to several locations for grooming. The Bellaire location gave one of my dogs the worst cut ever and the Pearland location cut my smallest pups ear and sent her to the ER! Still waiting to hear back from management since 12/31/25. Took a chance with Reahna at the Jones Rd location and it was the absolute best experience!!!! After some skepticism on how low I wanted their cuts , both of my pups were treated with the best care and came out looking like the cutest white chicks EVER!!! Thanks so much for doing well by my babies and we'll definitely be back. Biggest honorable mention to the bather ( I believe her name is Brandy, but sorry if I got it wrong) as she was a breath of fresh air as well.
Paperwork extremely friendly I really enjoyed it
Hi Sharon! Thanks a bunch for the 5-star shoutout! We're delighted you had a great experience. Looking forward to your next visit!
Hi Cameron! We love seeing those 5 stars! Thanks for stopping by, and we hope to welcome you back with wagging tails soon!

We love this place! Everyone who works there is so nice and friendly. I have a cocker spaniel that I take there to get groomed. Reahna  is excellent! She cares about the pups and their humans, and she always has provided great service and lots of love to my dog. We love her, we love her work, and we will continue to come back to see her!
my dog is absolutely terrible and the groomer so much trouble but she still got it done and he looks absolutely amazing. her name is reahna and i would definitely recommend booking her
Nice to have in the neighborhood and love the coupons but I have to pay better attention at the register as I’ve been overcharged a few times (twice this week).
Went here looking for new puppy stuff and found and very kind and knowledgeable employees at that!
This is our go-to for Primal frozen dog food. This store is great!

I love this store! I recently got a puppy and was greeted with a smiling face as soon as I walked through the doors. You don’t get that kind of customer service very often these days.

As a first-time pet owner, I wasn’t sure what to get or where to start. Luckily, Alyssa was working and helped me find everything I needed. She walked down the food aisle with me, explained all of my options, and even helped me choose a food that would be especially beneficial for my Doberman.

The prices were very reasonable, and Michele also signed me up for the rewards program and took the time to explain how it works.

I highly recommend this store to anyone with pets. It was well-stocked, clean, and staffed by genuinely helpful people. Michele at the register was also incredibly kind.

I will definitely be back!

I have been bringing my dogs here for years, but this was by far the worst experience I've had.

I went to wash my three dogs, and another customer had been drying her husky for a long time. There was dog hair everywhere. I finished washing my boxer and got about halfway through my shih tzu, but I couldn't finish my third dog because the hair was blowing into my eyes, my mouth, and all over my dogs. The area was a mess.

I asked the manager, Alyssa, if I could get a refund so I could come back another day. She refunded my money, but her attitude was rude and unprofessional the entire time. Instead of showing any understanding, she made an already frustrating situation worse.

I've always had positive experiences with the staff here, which is why this was so disappointing. I hope management addresses both the cleanliness of the dog wash area and the level of customer service being provided. Customers deserve to be treated with respect. Alyssa should be sent to customer service training.
Hi Marvin! A big thank you for the 5-star rating! We're so happy you enjoyed your time with us. Come back and visit anytime!
Reahna is the absolute best! She does amazing haircuts for my fur baby but she genuinely loves all the babies! I would highly recommend her.
Amazing staff and groomers!
This is probably my most favorite pet store. I can always find what I need and the Jersey Village location is always well stocked.

Omg, best customer service award goes to... (insert drum roll!) This location of Pet Supplies Plus! Best customer service I have EVER received  ANYWHERE!!!! The entire staff so helpful and friendly and patient!...unbelievable these days! And Marlie gets the Buzz Lightyear award....I wanted a particular raincoat for my baby girl and all they had was a small.... she stopped at NOTHING to try to help me get this raincoat,  even if she had to attempt to order it!  She really and truly went above and beyond; and was so patient and friendly! Long  story short, she found the raincoat and I was able to pick it up from another location!  This location is actually out of my way but,  I would totally drive that far to go to the store because the staff was just that amazing! And the vibe of the store, from ALL staff....utterly awesome and rare these days! I am not a robot or getting paid for this review! Hands down,  best service of my entire life!
Great selection! Friendly staff! We adopted a cat from here and they were very nice and helpful.

I definitely recommend this place. I was so discouraged because my pet hasn’t been to the doctors in so long but I was like you know what I’m gonna book the appointment the minute I walked in it was friendly faces. The doctor were so awesome Definitely recommend cares club

First time using Reahna. My dog Gracie desperately needed a nail trim, I met Reahna. She was friends, interactive and overall a wonderful first experience. I will definitely be bringing Gracie back for a bath and brush. Thank you Reahna!!

I have two new terrier mixes who were in desperate need of a spa treatment. This was a totally new experience for both them and myself. Reahna, the groomer, has probably become our new best friend. She had the patience of Job and talked them and me through the entire process. I felt like they would have left with her after she spent that time with them. They are so neat and clean and even more lovable than before. Thanks so much to Reahna! Truly a WONDERFUL experience!!!
Hi Mitchell! We appreciate the 5-star rating! It's always a pleasure to serve our pet-loving neighbors. Looking forward to your next visit!

The shop was a bit noisy because it was busy, but they still paid attention when I asked questions. I didn’t feel ignored even once, which made the whole process easier.

Reahna was so nice and my girl Roxy seemed happy to go with her. Definitely coming back for her next grooming sesh!
Reanna is very gentle with my Lhasa-poo and pays attention to how I'd like him to look.  She does his face better than any other groomer-so cute!
Reahna provided excellent customer service, she was friendly and attentive. She got our pup baby Peanut together.Thank you.

I am very disappointed with this location, had I known that two of the blowers at the self wash weren't working I would have taken my two dogs to the cypress location, it was very chaotic with another very reactive dog waiting to be bathed by owner barking & growling at any & everyone. Ended up coming home with two wet dogs. Not worth the $28 we paid.

Stopped by Pet Supplies Plus in Jersey Village yesterday and was so impressed with the variety they carry! I was able to find everything I needed for my dog — from a skin allergy treatment and detangling spray with clean ingredients to enzymatic toothpaste and treats. The store was clean and easy to shop. Definitely my new go-to for pet supplies!

Came here to grab some eye drops for my 11 month old void kitten, got inside and decided to check out the Kitten Wet Food options for my extremely picky 3 month tabby kitten, as I was walking around I heard some extremely aggravating sounds coming from a What looked to be birds cage, went in closer to see what kind of birds were making loud, cry’s out that sounded like kittens! Once I made it to the cages (there were 2 side by side) and both had kittens in them 😳!! The first one had 3 kittens in it 2 orange tabby’s and one black kitten! One of the Orange kittens was so aggravated he was loosing his mind!! There is absolutely NO where to run, play, hide, NOTHING!! 3 kittens are locked inside of a bird cage day in and day out 24/7 with no toys, no option to release energy!! The worst part is they are left locked inside the cages all night while the workers are gone home!! Just stuck there sitting on a hard plastic platform!! The cage is standing tall so there’s no platform at the bottom for any type of play the little space that is at the bottom houses their litter box, right next to it is a bowl of cheap kitten dry food, right in the middle of their poop, pee and food is their water poured into the birds feeder bowl!! They do not give them any type of wet food at all and says it’s against the adoption guidelines!! As you can see the cages are disgusting! The kittens are absolutely being abused every single day and then if you pay close enough attention to the very bottom behind the litter box you will see the little black tail poking out!! That is a kitten that’s been locked up in that cage since JUNE so 3 whole months 90 DAYS, 2,160 HOURS of day in and day out NEGLECT and he’s skinny and very small for his big age of now almost 5 months!! This is absolutely unacceptable!! I will NEVER spend another dollar in that store!! This is animal cruelty!!!
Thank you for your rating, Naheed. We hope to see you soon for another paw-some experience!

Sept. 2025: This store has gone down since being bought by the couple who owns the Cypress location. Fish section needs more dead-loss cleans and general maintenance, the ferrets are in an unlocked cage with a mountain of shit that is easily multiple days old, and the store smells of urine. I was a loyal PSP customer but then entire company is becoming worse than PetSmart and Petco since they've been making changes. I'm still mad I can't save my reward points like I used to.

2024: Their small pet temporary stays are REALLY small. Quality has gone down. Selections are slim, the fish and small animals are needing better upkeep, and customer service is.... slow.
15-20 minutes waiting for feeder fish (I recounted upon getting home and was short about 20 which is unacceptable since they charged me) and they were not accommodating when it comes to coupons because their site won't load and glitches out. It's like they think customers using coupons will take from their pay. I want to assure them that it has no effect on your income. I haven't had this problem at other locations.
⭐⭐❌❌❌

This store used to be great, but it seems like ever since they "upgraded their dog wash station" at either the end of last year or beginning of this year, the washing stations have been horrible.  The convenience of it was amazing but the last 3 visits were very inconvenient. (1) One large tub was down, (2) Then leads in both large tubs were broken, half the shampoos were completely empty and the dryer on one large tub was broken and (3) the washer/dryer was down so the towels couldn't be washed/dried; therefore rhe tubs were out of service. This $40 card is never going to be used up because I can't wash my dog.
Do not recommend dog grooming service at this location!! Had the worse experience ever. Please go somewhere else. I made the mistake of not reading the reviews before scheduling.

Went on Sunday night when a small Yorkie or dog (couldn’t for sure tell what breed) was being groomed, when we heard yelling in the store. We could hear things like “shut up” and I’m “I’m not playing with you” being yelled at the dog, and the dog was barking and clearly uncomfortable with the grooming process. Overall felt uncomfortable and unprofessional, wouldn’t want to bring my own dog here after over hearing that. If the groomers aren’t able to groom certain dogs they should deny service rather than yell at the dogs.

This shop has always seemed super well-stocked and clean to me. I urgently needed to bathe my dog ​​over the weekend and they gave me an appointment for Sunday, sending a confirmation for 3 pm. They called after 15 minutes and left a message asking if I wanted to come in 10 minutes. Obviously not. I was too far away and without my dog. Then they sent a message saying my appointment was at 3:30, then again at 3. When I arrived at 3, the lady greeted us politely and told us she'd be ready in a couple of hours. When she was ready, it didn't look like she'd had a bath; her neck smelled like urine and she was shedding much more than usual. I don't know if I'd go back.
Awesome!.great spot!

I've been taking my pet to get groomed here for years. Always happy but today I had an appointment to get groomed and the groomer acts like she doesn't like dogs. This is my second time going to her because she's new. I've tried to make appointments before and it looks like she's always calling in. The last time she groomed him she didn't do a very good job, looks like she needs more training. My dog is very playful, a little naughty, but not bad. He adapts to you if treated right. So anyway I ended up leaving because I didn't feel comfortable with her. If she don't like dogs, then she has no business working there.

Edit- update 2 years later I thought by now the service would have improved but unfortunately it hasn't. Saturday I had an appointment and right away I could tell something was wrong because the groomer didn't seem to happy. She had a very non-friendly attitude like she didn't feel like being there so just because my dog tried playing and licking her she said she wasn't gonna take him cause he mite bite her. I think you guys need to interview your groomers more thoroughly so they don't act like a sourpuss and say rude thing while I walk out like "you should invest in dog training" I think yall should invest in -NOT THAT I PLAN TO COME BACK IM SCARED FOR MY DOG but invest in a groomer has a better personality and loves animals while also loving her job. Unless you're ok with someone mistreating your dog because they're scared of em then I guess this is the place for you!
